data.text: More hook misses while choosing the hero prompt: 'Can we add an embedding model to search?' led with DEC-36 'rejected this before' — a decision about hooks, not about embeddings: a false alarm of exactly the kind the 0.8.1 measurement counted as zero. 'Let's add embeddings so search understands synonyms' and 'Let's put embeddings in the core…' returned DEC-26 without rejected-before, or not at all.
